spec.query:
source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| stats count() as total_alerts

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'authentication_success')
| stats count() as successful_auth

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'authentication_failed')
| stats count() as attempts by `data.srcip`
| sort - attempts
| head 10

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'syscheck')
| stats count() as events by `syscheck.event`
| sort - events

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'syscheck')
| stats count() as events by `syscheck.path`
| sort - events
| head 10

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'syscheck')
| fields `@timestamp`, `agent.name`, `syscheck.event`, `syscheck.path`, `rule.level`, `rule.description`
| sort - `@timestamp`
| head 20

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where match_phrase(`rule.groups`, 'syscheck')
| stats count() as fim_events

source = wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| stats count() as total_vulnerabilities

source = wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| stats count() as affected by `vulnerability.id`
| sort - affected
| head 10

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where `rule.level` >= 12 and `rule.level` <= 16
| stats count() as level_12_16

source = wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| stats count() as vulnerabilities by `package.name`
| sort - vulnerabilities
| head 10

source = wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| stats count() as vulnerabilities by `agent.name`
| sort - vulnerabilities

source = wazuh-states-vulnerabilities-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| eval severity = if(`vulnerability.severity` = '-', 'Unrated',
    if(isnull(`vulnerability.severity`), 'Unrated',
    if(`vulnerability.severity` = '', 'Unrated', `vulnerability.severity`)))
| fields `vulnerability.detected_at`,
         `agent.name`,
         `vulnerability.id`,
         severity,
         `package.name`,
         `package.version`,
         `vulnerability.description`
| sort - `vulnerability.detected_at`
| head 100

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')
| where `rule.level` >= 12
| stats distinct_count(`rule.id`) as critical_rules

source = wazuh-alerts-*
| where like(`agent.name`, '$agent')

| stats count() as rootcheck_events

source = wazuh-alerts-*

source = wazuh-alerts-*

source = wazuh-alerts-*

| where `rule.level` >= 8

source = wazuh-alerts-*
